tiles.title: Top 16 routes on alert (by avg delay)
Stops with most delayed routes (last 5 min)
How to read this dashboard
tiles.markdownText:
A route is **on alert** when its average delay stays above **3 min** in consecutive readings (~1 per minute).

**Small text = current avg delay** · **Big number = route**

**Color = how long the route has been on alert:** 🔵 5–9 min · 🟡 10–14 · 🟠 15–19 · 🔴 20+

**Dots = buses 3+ min late right now** (max 5)

Click a bar in the stops chart to filter by stop · **Reset** (top right) to clear filters

queries.text:
let umbral = toscalar(at_config_params
    | where param_name == "vehicle_delay_threshold_seconds"
    | summarize arg_max(updated_at, param_value)
    | project todouble(param_value));
let rutas_del_paradero = at_recent_live_updates(5m)
    | where coalesce(arrival_delay_seconds, departure_delay_seconds) >= umbral
    | lookup kind=leftouter (at_stops_ref | project stop_id, stop_name) on stop_id
    | where coalesce(stop_name, stop_id) == _stop
    | distinct route_id;
at_get_route_severity()
| where is_active
| where isempty(_stop) or route_id in (rutas_del_paradero)
| extend nivel_orden = case(alert_level == "roja", 4, alert_level == "naranja", 3, alert_level == "amarilla", 2, 1)
| extend icono = case(alert_level == "roja", "🔴", alert_level == "naranja", "🟠", alert_level == "amarilla", "🟡", "🔵")
| extend puntos = strrep(icono, max_of(min_of(affected_vehicles, 5), 1))
| order by nivel_orden desc, severity_score desc
| take 16
| order by nivel_orden desc, avg_delay_seconds desc
| extend d = avg_delay_seconds
| extend retraso = case(
    d < 60,   strcat(tostring(toint(round(d, 0))), " s"),
    d < 3600, strcat(tostring(round(d / 60.0, 1)), " min"),
              strcat(tostring(toint(d / 3600)), " h ", tostring(toint((d % 3600) / 60)), " min"))
| project
    Route = tostring(split(route_id, "-")[0]),
    Delay = strcat(puntos, "  ", retraso),
    route_id

let umbral = toscalar(at_config_params
    | where param_name == "vehicle_delay_threshold_seconds"
    | summarize arg_max(updated_at, param_value)
    | project todouble(param_value));
let rutas_del_paradero = at_recent_live_updates(5m)
    | where coalesce(arrival_delay_seconds, departure_delay_seconds) >= umbral
    | lookup kind=leftouter (at_stops_ref | project stop_id, stop_name) on stop_id
    | where coalesce(stop_name, stop_id) == _stop
    | distinct route_id;
let paraderos = at_recent_live_updates(5m)
    | where coalesce(arrival_delay_seconds, departure_delay_seconds) >= umbral
    | lookup kind=leftouter (at_stops_ref | project stop_id, stop_name) on stop_id
    | extend paradero = coalesce(stop_name, stop_id)
    | summarize Paraderos = strcat_array(make_set(paradero, 5), " · ") by route_id;
at_get_route_severity()
| where is_active
| where isempty(_stop) or route_id in (rutas_del_paradero)
| lookup kind=leftouter paraderos on route_id
| extend s = signals_breakdown
| extend mag = todouble(s.magnitude), amp = todouble(s.amplitude), tre = todouble(s.trend), racha = toint(s.consecutive_readings)
| extend dominante = case(mag >= amp and mag >= tre, "Magnitude", amp >= tre, "Amplitude", "Trend")
| extend nivel_orden = case(alert_level == "roja", 4, alert_level == "naranja", 3, alert_level == "amarilla", 2, 1)
| order by nivel_orden desc, severity_score desc
| project
    Level = case(
        alert_level == "roja", "🔴 red",
        alert_level == "naranja", "🟠 orange",
        alert_level == "amarilla", "🟡 yellow",
        "🔵 warning"),
    Route = tostring(split(route_id, "-")[0]),
    ['Next stops (delayed buses)'] = Paraderos,
    ['Avg delay (min)'] = round(avg_delay_seconds / 60.0, 1),
    ['Affected vehicles'] = affected_vehicles,
    Trend = case(
        trend == "estable", "stable",
        trend == "empeorando", "worsening",
        trend == "mejorando", "improving",
        trend),
    ['Last reading'] = last_seen,
    Severity = round(severity_score, 2),
    ['Dominant signal'] = dominante,
    Magnitude = round(mag, 3),
    Amplitude = round(amp, 3),
    ['Trend contribution'] = round(tre, 3),
    ['Min. in alert (approx.)'] = iff(racha >= 30, "30+", tostring(racha)),
    ['Route ID'] = route_id

let umbral = toscalar(at_config_params
    | where param_name == "vehicle_delay_threshold_seconds"
    | summarize arg_max(updated_at, param_value)
    | project todouble(param_value));
let activas = at_get_route_severity() | where is_active | project route_id;
at_recent_live_updates(5m)
| where route_id in (activas)
| where isempty(_route) or tostring(split(route_id, "-")[0]) == _route
| where coalesce(arrival_delay_seconds, departure_delay_seconds) >= umbral
| summarize ['Delayed routes'] = dcount(route_id) by stop_id
| lookup kind=leftouter (at_stops_ref | project stop_id, stop_name) on stop_id
| extend Stop = coalesce(stop_name, stop_id)
| top 10 by ['Delayed routes'] desc
| project Stop, ['Delayed routes']

let r = at_get_route_severity();
union
    (r | summarize Value = countif(alert_level != "sin_datos") | extend Indicator = "Routes running now", ord = 1),
    (r | summarize Value = countif(is_active) | extend Indicator = "Routes on alert", ord = 2),
    (r | summarize Value = countif(alert_level == "sin_datos") | extend Indicator = "Routes not reporting (24h)", ord = 3),
    (r | summarize Value = datetime_diff('minute', now(), max(last_seen)) | extend Indicator = "Min. since last reading", ord = 4)
| order by ord asc
| project Indicator, Value

at_get_route_severity()
| where is_active
| project route_id, Route = tostring(split(route_id, "-")[0])
| order by Route asc

let umbral = toscalar(at_config_params
    | where param_name == "vehicle_delay_threshold_seconds"
    | summarize arg_max(updated_at, param_value)
    | project todouble(param_value));
at_recent_live_updates(5m)
| where coalesce(arrival_delay_seconds, departure_delay_seconds) >= umbral
| lookup kind=leftouter (at_stops_ref | project stop_id, stop_name) on stop_id
| distinct Stop = coalesce(stop_name, stop_id)
| order by Stop asc
